_comment: The fixture corpus. R0 creates S0 and S1 (r0-benchmarks.md section 2);
later releases add their own and register them here.
A fixture with build.status other than 'built' is reported NOT_RUN by
the harness, with the reason carried through to the manifest. It is
never silently omitted from a run: a fixture that quietly stops being
listed is a fixture that regresses unnoticed (ci.md section 11).

fixtures.definition: 1 M triangles across plane, sphere, cubes, sloped surfaces, with fixed overlapping and near-plane cases

build.reason: no cooker and no scene format yet; S0 is authored during R0

fixtures.definition: 10 M unique triangles, ten dense rigid meshes, hard edges, UV seams, multiple material sections
fixtures.serves: Pulled forward from R1. At R0 a single 10 M source mesh with no engine format is enough -- the clusterlod.h builder run needs geometry, not a cooked package

build.reason: source mesh not yet acquired; needed for the clusterlod.h builder measurement
